reviews.text:
I hate when I feel products on my face. This I honestly can’t feel and it’s so skin like. I have fine hair and I love how this doesn’t make my hair around mu face greasy.
I bought it again because that’s how much I love it.
Also great at not braking me out or irritate my sensitive skin. Rant aside amazing product.
reviews.zh: 我好怕面上有嘢嘅感覺。呢枝真係完全感覺唔到，好貼膚。我面上有少少毛，我好鍾意佢唔會令我面毛位油笠笠。我再買多枝就知我幾愛佢。仲有完全唔會令我爆瘡或者刺激到我敏感肌。講到尾係超正嘅產品。

reviews.text: Sensitive Skin/Long time RL Customer. Can only get it here. Always OOS on US site. I have seriously sensitive skin. This stuff works wonders all day for me. Honestly, my skin feels softer after applying this compared to the DOKDO Moisturizer (which is also apart of my skincare routine). My skin feels soft and baby smooth. My husband gets blown away every time I use this and I always do. Been using this for a couple months now that I've got my hands on it and have had zero issues. First sunscreen I have tried that does not leave a film, oil, or coat-like feeling on skin. Simply natural skin that's got a baby soft feel to it. I've been using the DOKDO skincare line for 3-4 years now religiously.
reviews.zh: 敏感肌/RL長期客戶。淨係度買到。美國網成日缺貨。我皮膚真係好敏感。呢枝嘢全日都幫到我好多。講真，搽完之後皮膚比起DOKDO保濕霜（亦都係我護膚程序之一）仲要滑。皮膚軟綿綿好似BB咁滑。我老公每次見到我用都讚嘆，我次次都用。拎到貨之後連續用咗幾個月，完全冇問題。第一枝我用過唔會留膜、油笠笠或者有塗層感覺嘅防曬。純粹係自然嘅皮膚，但有BB般滑嘅觸感。我已經虔誠地用咗DOKDO嘅護膚系列3-4年。

reviews.text: So far I’ve only tried this for one day. The texture is very nice and very lightweight. I’ve never used a lightweight sunscreen before, so I was pleasantly surprised! It’s even lighter than my current moisturizer! If you do tap your skin after application though, it is a little sticky. I also have normal, but borderline dry skin. I think at the time I put this on, I had dry skin even after moisturizing, so it kind of stung my face. It leaves a shiny, but not overly shiny look on my face, which I don’t mind. I have a peachy-coral-gold skin tone, and it doesn’t leave a white cast! The finish is like I just came out of the shower. Shiny and clean looking!
reviews.zh: 暫時我只係用咗一日。質地好好好輕。我之前從未用過咁輕嘅防曬，所以有驚喜！比起我而家用緊嘅保濕霜仲要輕！不過如果你搽完之後拍打皮膚，會有少少黐。我皮膚係正常但接近乾性。我覺得嗰陣我搽嘅時候，雖然已經搽咗保濕霜，皮膚都仲係乾，所以有少少拮面。搽完面會有光澤但又唔會太亮，我自己都接受到。我嘅膚色係桃色—珊瑚—金色調，佢完全冇泛白！妝效就好似我啱啱沖完涼出嚟，亮亮地好乾淨！

reviews.text:
GATEKEEP THIS ONE!!🤫
Maybe even better than the birch?
Very, but very lightweight formulation- so light, I cant even feel it on my skin (lighter than the la roche posay liquid sunscreen).
Very good for oily dehydrated skin. Okay for dry skin, but the birch will be better for hydration.
KEEP IT IN SECRET 🤫
reviews.zh: 呢枝要收埋！！🤫 可能仲勁過birch？非常、非常輕嘅配方——輕到完全感覺唔到喺皮膚上（比起la roche posay嘅液體防曬仲要輕）。油性缺水肌超啱用。乾性肌都okay，但想要保濕嘅話birch會好啲。收埋佢 🤫

reviews.text: So... I thought this was THE roundlab suncream that everyone was talking about(it's the birch one btw.) But honestly, this sunscreen is so lightweight and moisturizing that I do not feel like I lost out for my accidental purchase. It's unscented and moisturizing, but it doesn't have that weird oily feel to it! I'm pale and I wear this daily and I haven't noticed any irritation or acne from it. A win for Roundlab!
reviews.zh: 咁…我以為呢隻就係大家講到好勁嗰隻 roundlab suncream（順帶一提，係 birch 嗰隻）。但老實講，呢隻防曬超輕身又保濕，我完全冇覺得自己因為意外買咗而蝕底。佢冇香味又保濕，但完全冇嗰種怪怪嘅油笠感！我膚色偏白，每日都用，到而家都未試過因此刺激或者爆瘡。Roundlab 贏咗！

reviews.text:
I bought this when they were out of stock of the Birch Juice Sunscreen, but happened to find a product I now enjoy. 

I love the texture as its moisturizing and doesn't feel like a typical thick formula, plus it doesn't leave a white cast on my skin tone. It doesn't feel sticky after either.

Since it's still winter where I live, the formula seems to have enough sun protection for most of the day when I'm out. But during the summer, I would likely have to reapply it more often. 

I didn't originally intend to buy this but I ended up liking it a lot more than I expected!
reviews.zh:
我買呢個嘅時候佢哋嘅 Birch Juice Sunscreen 斷貨，點知俾我撞到一隻而家好鍾意嘅產品。

我好鍾意佢嘅質地，夠保濕又唔似一般防曬咁厚重，而且喺我嘅膚色上面唔會泛白。之後都唔會覺得黏笠。

我住嗰邊而家仲係冬天，呢個配方出街大部份時間都夠防曬。但到咗夏天，我應該就要頻密啲補塗。

本來唔係特登買佢，但結果我鍾意嘅程度遠超預期！

reviews.text: So underrated!! This one is creamy and moisturising and feels great on my dry skin. Not greasy at all. Great for all skin in the winter but especially great for combo/dry skin. I prefer this to the round lab birch juice one, as this is easier to apply. It melts into the skin a lot faster. I personally found the Birch Juice has a thick gel like film that takes a while to set, and also has a faint white cast. Feels like you’re applying a light hydrating cream. I love this so much I wished this would come out in a twin pack plz!!
reviews.zh: 真係太被低估！！呢隻好 creamy 又保濕，搽上我塊乾肌好舒服。完全唔油笠。冬天任何膚質都啱用，尤其適合混合性／乾性肌。比起 round lab Birch Juice 嗰隻我更加鍾意呢隻，因為易推好多。佢溶入皮膚嘅速度快好多。我自己用落覺得 Birch Juice 嗰隻有層好厚嘅 gel 膜，要等好耐先至成膜，而且有少少泛白。感覺就好似搽緊一層輕身嘅保濕霜。我太鍾意呢隻，好想佢出孖裝拜託！！

reviews.text: This is a very nice sunscreen. I dislike sunscreen that’s very greasy and sometimes sunscreen makes me break out, but this one did not! Like one of the other comments, this sunscreen is very moisturizing and feels like a moisturizer. I always use it on days I’m wearing makeup and it’s a perfect base under my cushion.
reviews.zh: 呢隻防曬好正。我一向怕咗嗰啲好油笠嘅防曬，有時防曬仲會令我爆瘡，但呢隻就唔會！同其他留言講嘅一樣，呢隻防曬好保濕，感覺好似搽緊保濕霜。我化妝嘅日子一定用佢，佢做我塊 cushion 嘅底霜一流。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
